about: Bolt seeker: IR observation -> 36-neuron egocentric ring of log-evidence plus 10 distance bands -> steering. Evidence neurons sum their input per step and their rate is the softmax over their group; the ring is shifted against the Bolt's turn (yaw) and by the parallax of the believed distance as the locator moves and forgets by the potential parallax of the step (tauParallax), the distance slid along the bearing and forgetting with the travel (tauCm); every other neuron is max(0, bias + sum of weight * rate).
